environment_not_connected_description: Connect this chat’s environment to use its simulators.
offline_description: Reconnect it to see its devices. Environments running an older Zuse server need an update.
setup_description_both: Run iOS simulators and Android emulators beside the chat, and let agents check their own work.
setup_description_android: Run Android emulators beside the chat, and let agents check their own work.
agents_toggle_description: Agents can open apps, tap, type and take screenshots. You can change this later.
recheck_on_return: Zuse checks again when you come back.
installs_hub: Installs device hub {{hub}} for Zuse. Your SDKs aren’t changed.
installs_hub_and_agent: Installs device hub {{hub}} and agent tools {{agent}} for Zuse. Your SDKs aren’t changed.
preparing_description: The first setup downloads the device hub and can take a minute.
session_ended: That device’s session ended. Choose one to reopen.
empty_description: Add one in Xcode or Android Studio, then refresh.
in_use_elsewhere: Another chat is using this device. Close it there first.
screen_label: {{name}} screen. Click to touch; typing goes to the device.
decode_failed: This window couldn’t decode the emulator’s video. Reconnect to try again.
input_backed_up: Input is backed up. Release the controls and try again.
stream_disconnected: Device stream disconnected. Retry to reconnect.
settings_subtitle: Run iOS simulators and Android emulators beside your chats, and choose whether agents can use them.
settings_description: Preview apps on iOS simulators and Android emulators in a chat’s side panel. Devices run on this computer; each chat opens its own.
settings_unavailable: This computer’s simulator service is unavailable.
agent_access_description: Agents can open devices, tap, type and take screenshots to check their work. Turn off to keep controls manual.
requirements_description: Checked on this computer. Fixes run only when you choose them.
tools_footer: Downloaded on first use at pinned versions into Zuse’s data folder, separately from your projects.
device_hub_description: expo-device-hub {{version}} · streams iOS and Android screens and sends touch and keyboard input
agent_tools_description: agent-device {{version}} · lets agents read and operate the app
summary_idle: On · starts when you open a device
